contract.compressionOptions: level?:int; absent calls Compression::default()==6; validate explicit0..9 before backend construction. Format is one of gzip,zlib,raw for adapters; six named buffer operations fix their format.
contract.decompressionOptions: maxOutputBytes?:int; absent has no expansion ceiling. Explicit nonnegative target-fitting count is enforced incrementally before retaining excess decoded bytes; zero permits only empty output.
contract.gzip: GzBuilder mtime0/OS255, no filename/comment; MultiGzDecoder consumes every concatenated member and rejects non-gzip suffix. Verify deterministic metadata and checksum/ISIZE/truncation.
contract.zlibAndRaw: bufread decoder validates backend StreamEnd on EOF; reject any unconsumed suffix. zlib verifies Adler32; raw DEFLATE has no checksum and cannot detect every bit flip.
contract.writerFinish: Raw/zlib writer prototype uses flate2::Decompress status to certify StreamEnd, preserving strict truncation/trailing semantics; gzip uses backend MultiGzDecoder. Sink/flush/finish failures propagate. Drop is not a successful finish.
contract.ownership: Transforms own source/sink and backend state; exclusive read/write, explicit finish transfers inner resource once. No owner cloning, arbitrary per-stream cap, or unsafe facade code.
contract.errors: Preserve checked level/format/policy categories and underlying I/O operation/OS-code/error fields. Pool admission/completion/cancellation uses existing typed B06 transport, not string erasure. Exact public error record remains pending backend and B05 integration review.
contract.asyncEntrypoints: Owner/integrator accepted explicit caller ThreadPool/submission capability plus owned Bytes/state, returning Task<Result<...>>; retain typed pool admission/completion failures. Never implicitly clone borrowed ByteViews, introduce a hidden pool or use unbounded spawn_blocking. Reader/writer transforms retain one owned state and explicit finish; async I/O remains outside the CPU-worker blocking boundary as appropriate.

integration.B02: Borrow Bytes/ByteView for whole buffers; return independently owned Bytes; no Vec retention bridge when existing byte ownership can move.
integration.B05: Current stdlib-io-integration has owned Reader/Writer enum and staged blocking resources plus HTTP Bytes frames; compression requires a finite codec resource variant or owned staging hook, not a trait-object global registry. Preserve readInto, partial bytes and cancellation settlement. No B05 source modified.
integration.B06: Use explicit owned ThreadPool.submission capability and taskAsync for CPU work; lazy admission, full/closed typed errors, cancellation before start drops capture, after start waits noninterruptible codec work and drains children. No hidden global unbounded pool. Existing B06 witnesses reusable; compression-state capture/cancellation witness remains required. Prepared pool-contract.rs includes the exact existing futures/core/async runtime, with lazy/full/closed, queued owner drop-once, started CPU cancellation/drain and owned compressed result witnesses. Compilation/execution pending separate existing Tokio+Rayon artifact lease; no private pool replacement.

profile.output: Exact144fixture keys/engine, domains and duplicate checks; every compressed fixture is independently decoded to full expected bytes. Compression samples/allocations join that fixture size/checksum; all31sample checksum/length/duration cells are externally validated. Decode outputs join independent original bytes/checksum. Negative validator self-checks reject altered matrix/domain/checksum/length/duration and retained bytes.
profile.resources: per-process CPU user/system and peak RSS; exact Rust per-operation allocation requested/peak/retained scoped separately
profile.pending: All compiler/native executions, source self-checks, dependency locked-feature/target validation, async B05/B06 state-capture witness, generated facade and full package/export acceptance.

Full6groups total2592timing rows=80352samples plus20736warmups and1728Rust allocation rows. Each format.operation group48cases completes3processes×3engines (9timing scopes), and6Rust allocation scopes; complete group written before next. Subset selection preserves original protocol without repeating already measured groups.
profile.decodeCorpus: One24-file Node-generated immutable corpus (3formats×2patterns×4levels) shared byte-for-byte across both Rust backends, Node and both reader/writer strategies. Record SHA256/length/checksum, verify before/after each complete group. Own-backend encoder round trips remain separate correctness evidence.
profile.failureArtifacts: Announce COMPRESSION_SCOPE_DIR before compilation. Preserve immutable corpus, binaries, source/dependency hashes, command stdout/stderr, validated process scopes and complete groups on failure; no source snapshots. Successful scratch removed after final JSON publication. TSRUST_COMPRESSION_GROUPS selects whole format.operation groups for remaining timings, each retaining3processes×31samples after8warmups.
profile.cleanupBoundary: Node Transform resolves only after readable end and codec close, matching completion plus disposal of Rust codec state; timed output checksum observation remains included. Exact Node zlib version is reported. No Node allocator-equivalence claim.
